dossier.architecture: Modular turret scorer with progressively simplified acquisition and interchangeable climb concepts.

subsystems.drivetrain: SDS swerve; modular structure supports repeated revisions.
subsystems.intake: Pneumatic flex-wheel design evolved to motorized roller pickup; bumper covering selected for ball grip.
subsystems.transfer: Two sensor-tracked chambers and compliant feed rollers; wrong-color cargo rejected through a slower shot.
subsystems.scoring: Over-360-degree turret and motorized adjustable hood; high camera mount retains near-goal target view.
subsystems.endgame: Dual gas-spring telescopes for traversal; separate passive high-bar prototype brought as an alternative, not assumed fielded.
subsystems.controls: Vision-corrected odometry, moving-shot compensation, intermediate pickup pose and gyro-based climb timing.

versions: Team reports four broad robot iterations. Removed pneumatics, changed intake contact material and replaced servo hood actuation with a motor.
dossier.analysis: Compare whole configurations: the lower-priority climb was designed around the scorer, and the team explicitly considered a faster, lower-scoring endgame when late-cycle output was valuable.
limits: Only published/reviewed configurations are established; further intermediate changes may be undocumented.

context_documents.body:
# 2022-4414: Repeated intake iterations must remain attached to the correct shooter snapshot

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

The team reports several whole-robot iterations. The retained account distinguishes early pneumatic flex-wheel collection from later motorized rollers, sensor-tracked cargo chambers, a wide-range turret and a high-mounted targeting camera.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The interview emphasizes rapid fabrication/iteration and material testing. More exact performance attribution requires the dated release/configuration, not the number of iterations alone.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

A camera mounted to preserve near-goal visibility changes the available aiming envelope. Color/rejection and staged possession must still coordinate with turret direction. Do not combine every photographed intake into one version.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Validate close-range sight lines, rejection trajectory and intake/feed readiness after a mechanism swap.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.
